channel.title: Angelo Corsaro — Blog
channel.description: Writing on Zenoh, distributed systems, and robotics by Angelo Corsaro, Ph.D.

item.title: Adieu ZettaScale
item.description: Adieu ZettaScale. The next chapter starts now.

item.title: Coupling Clocks: How Fireflies Inspired a Distributed Clock Synchronization Algorithm
item.description: A look back at the coupling-based internal clock synchronization algorithm I co-developed — using the same mathematics that describes flashing fireflies and beating hearts to synchronize clocks across tens of thousands of nodes without any external time reference.

item.title: Why I Created Zenoh
item.description: The story behind the Zenoh protocol — why existing middleware wasn't enough, and what we set out to build.

item.title: How the ROS 2 Core Team Chose Zenoh as Its Alternative Middleware
item.description: An overview of the official ROS 2 core team study that evaluated alternative middlewares to DDS — and concluded that Zenoh best meets the requirements of modern robotics systems.
